title: Outputs index API (active project)
notes: Add a small API to list output files for the active project (path, mtime, size, kind) similar to materials index, and cap results. This enables PWA observability without requiring filesystem access.
acceptance: GET /api/outputs/index returns ok=true with files[] under runtime/projects/<active>/outputs
Indexing is capped (e.g. 5000 entries) and sorted for stability
